meta.title: Freemans Universal Organization | Ten Orbits, One World
meta.description: Freemans Universal Organization (Ahrar) is a global network of free people across ten departments: talent, peace, sustainable development, technology & AI, security, human rights and more.

hero.lead: We are a global network of free people. Across ten departments — from elite talent and artificial intelligence to world peace and sustainable development — we design and build a shared future.

stage.title: Ten departments. One mission.
stage.lead: Every orbit is a department; every particle, a free person. Hover the orbits — or choose from the list below.

departments.title: The ten orbits
departments.lead: Each department is an independent orbit with a shared direction. Choose one and go deep.

talent.name: Talent & Elite Recruitment
talent.description: We identify exceptional talent anywhere in the world and turn them into tomorrow's stewards through growth programs, fellowships and network-building.

peace.name: Universalism & World Peace
peace.description: We turn dialogue between cultures into common action — from multilingual forums to social reconciliation projects. Peace is something you build, not something you wish for.

sustainability.name: Sustainable Development
sustainability.description: For a future whose resources are enough for everyone: we design and run local water, clean-energy and circular-economy projects together with host communities.

technology.name: Technology & Artificial Intelligence
technology.description: We want technology in the service of human dignity — from responsible AI systems to open-source tools that give free people agency anywhere on Earth.

organization.name: Organizational Development & Systems
organization.description: We build structures and systems that make civil-society organizations agile, transparent and durable — from internal governance to process architecture.

security.name: Security & Cybersecurity
security.description: We protect civil-society actors, data and critical infrastructure. Security is a precondition of freedom — so we put it within everyone's reach through training and tools.

rights.name: Politics & Human Rights
rights.description: Through research, advocacy and policy work we defend fundamental human rights and carry the voice of free people to the tables where decisions are made.

media.name: Social Networks & Content Production
media.description: We tell the story of freedom in the world's languages — accurate, creative, multilingual content that builds awareness and invites participation.

capital.name: Capital Attraction & Financing
capital.description: We secure sustainable, transparent resources for the mission — from micro-donations to impact investment. Every unit of currency has a clear path.

partnerships.name: Support, Cooperation & Startups
partnerships.description: We are the bridge between idea and execution — accelerating social startups and brokering partnerships that turn cooperation into products and services.

home.missionText: "Ahrar" means the free — those who treat freedom not as a slogan but as a responsibility. We believe the world's future gets built when free people everywhere stop being separate islands and become one aligned constellation.
home.impactLead: Every number has a clear path — from source to outcome. Our reports are published openly.
home.joinText: Ten orbits, ten ways to make an impact. Join, support, or bring your startup into the network — there is an open place for you in this constellation.

mission.title: Mission & Values
mission.lead: One direction, five values, ten orbits.
mission.statement: Our mission is to organize the free people of the world to build a future in which dignity, freedom and opportunity are everyone's right, not a privilege of the few. Our vision is an aligned world: ten departments, thousands of projects, one direction.

freedom.name: Freedom
freedom.text: We treat freedom as responsibility: every member is free to choose, to critique and to build their own path — and accountable for those choices.

dignity.name: Dignity
dignity.text: No human being is a means. In every project, people's dignity comes before indicators and numbers.

solidarity.name: Solidarity
solidarity.text: We don't build separate islands; we build orbits that reinforce each other. Every member's success is the constellation's success.

transparency.name: Transparency
transparency.text: From resources to impact, everything is traceable. Our financial and performance reports are public.

wisdom.name: Collective wisdom
wisdom.text: Decisions are made with data, dialogue and shared experience — not with the loudest voice, but with the clearest reason.

how.title: Impact
how.text: We accompany each project to measurable impact — and report it.

about.title: About Ahrar
about.lead: The story of a network that turned an organization into a constellation.
about.storyTitle: From one question to one constellation
story: Ahrar began with a simple question: why are the free people of the world, with all their power, scattered? Our answer became a metaphor: a constellation. Instead of a hierarchical organization, we built a network of orbits — each with an independent mission and a shared direction.

Today the network is active across ten departments, from elite talent and AI to peace, security and human rights. Each department works like an orbit in the organization's astrolabe: independent in motion, concentric in direction.
Our name carries two promises. "Universal" means no border limits our reach. "Ahrar" — the free — means no member is ever another's instrument. These two promises determine our architecture.

news.lead: Living stories from the network — from the peace forum to the AI lab.

items.title: The Ahrar AI co-creation fellowship begins
items.excerpt: The first responsible-AI fellowship opened with 30 researchers from 12 countries.
body: The Technology & AI department launched the first "Ahrar Co-Creation" fellowship with 30 researchers from 12 countries. The six-month program focuses on building responsible AI systems for civil society.
Fellows advance projects along three tracks — open-source tools, data literacy and algorithmic security — and present their output to the network's general assembly every month.
According to the department's steward, the goal is for AI to become an instrument for distributing opportunity rather than concentrating power.
The fellowship is supported by the Strategic Cooperation Fund, and all of its output will be published open-source.

items.title: Universal Peace Forum: dialogue in 12 languages
items.excerpt: The fourth annual peace forum gathered representatives of 42 countries with live interpretation in 12 languages.
body: The fourth Universal Peace Forum, hosted by the Universalism & World Peace department, brought together representatives of 42 countries for three days of dialogue on social reconciliation, cross-cultural understanding and human security.
This edition's signature was live interpretation in 12 languages and the design of "aligned tables" — tables where, instead of speeches, every participant offered one practical commitment.
The forum produced 18 shared commitments, now running as local projects whose progress is reported publicly.
The fifth forum is planned for next year, and the call to host it will be published soon.

items.title: The 2026 Sustainable Development Report is out
items.excerpt: A year of water, clean-energy and circular-economy projects across 16 countries, documented.
body: The Sustainable Development department released its annual report — a document covering 16 water and clean-energy projects and 9 circular-economy initiatives across 16 countries.
According to the report, water projects gave 12,000 households durable access, and circular initiatives returned the waste of 34 neighborhoods to the recovery cycle.
The report was prepared with an independent audit methodology, and its raw data is publicly available to researchers.
The full report, together with CSV data, can be downloaded from the Impact page.

items.title: The third partnership accelerator cohort
items.excerpt: Ten social startups from four continents joined the Ahrar acceleration network.
body: The Partnerships & Startups department opened its third accelerator cohort, admitting 10 social startups from four continents.
The cohort focuses on three fields — technology for access, circular economy and free media — and each team receives a network steward and a financial support package.
At the end of the program, teams present their products to impact investors at "Ahrar Demo Day".
The call for the fourth cohort will be published this winter.
